answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 35184 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is it lawful for mo'takif to take bath inside the mosque or outside the mosque Question: Is it lawful for mo'takif to take bath inside the mosque or outside the mosque? Answer ID: 35184 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1711/1711/M=1432) If ghusl is wajib on mutakif then he can go out of the mosque to take bath. If it is not wajib then it is not allowed for him to go out. Yes, he can take a bath in the mosque in a way that the water of ghusl does not fall on the floor of the mosque. He should take a bath sitting in a big tub etc carefully. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
